note: P3823 (Pro 6:22) — when you walk they lead you; when you lie down they watch; when you awake they talk with you. (watch = teaching's action, qualifier.)

dims.v: inner communion — the internalised teaching converses with you
the teaching become an inner companion that talks/communes with the son on waking
the communion coupled to the teaching's guarding

siach (commune/meditate/talk) — 'when you awake, they will talk with you'; the word so internalised it becomes an inner interlocutor, a companion in meditation. The teaching's WATCHING (shamar) is its personified guarding (qualifier).
